scope_note: Residual synthesis after the Google The Dalles public-source audit. Only three low-confidence descriptive county comparison gaps are retained because the direct record does not identify causal county outcomes. Each benchmark uses the available 2001-2005 pre-opening history, excludes all study counties from a 20-county inverse-distance-weighted donor pool, and carries a fit-sensitivity envelope. No model converts broad investment or permit values to jobs, onsite contractor counts to supplier output, utility-system loads to campus consumption, tax bills to payments, or unmatched incentive formulas and public costs to a fiscal net.

estimates.label: Modeled county real GDP comparison gap

period.label: 2024 Wasco County outcome relative to a mechanically matched benchmark; campus opening year 2006

scope.label: Google The Dalles campus and Wasco County

interval.interpretation: The envelope is plus or minus twice the 2001-2005 pre-period RMSE. It is a fit sensitivity, not a statistical confidence interval.

parameters.name: comparison_2024_value
parameters.transformation: Subtracted from host and used as denominator

estimates.confidence_rationale: The benchmark is reproducible, but the pre-period is only five years and the 18-year post-opening interval contains later campus expansions and unrelated county shocks.
estimates.decision_relevance: Shows Wasco County's 2024 real-GDP divergence from a transparent comparison benchmark without assigning the difference to Google.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: A causal design with complete county exposure history, treatment isolation, pre-trends, placebos, spillover rules and robustness checks

assumptions: Matching uses 2001-2005 log level, average log growth and growth volatility.
All selected-study counties are excluded from the donor pool.
The 2006 opening is not assumed to be the county's first data-center exposure or an isolated treatment date.

limitations: This comparison is descriptive and must not be interpreted as a data-center effect.
Later campus expansions, hydropower and other concurrent county changes are not isolated.
The donor screen cannot exclude every unobserved treatment.
The interval is fit sensitivity, not statistical confidence.
estimates.notes: Descriptive benchmark gap only; no causal_design metadata is attached.
